title: Brace PowerShell variables adjacent to Git refspec colons
failure_signature: An unbraced branch variable next to a colon produced an invalid fetch refspec after x1 commit and push.
trigger_preconditions: A variable is immediately followed by a colon
The resulting string is a Git source-to-destination refspec
candidate_workaround: Use ${branch} around each branch interpolation, rerun only the failed fetch and equality proof, and credit equality only after live-remote comparison succeeds.
recurrence_guard: Brace variables at punctuation boundaries and report earlier child-command success separately from a later orchestration failure.
rollback: Do not alter the successful commit or push; stop before x2 and rerun only the read-only or remote-tracking proof operation.
scope_boundary: This method validates refspec construction and equality proof only; it provides no scientific, authority, privacy, identity, deployment, or independent-reproduction evidence.
